package.name: unitree_policy_bridge
package.description: Robot-agnostic manifest-driven policy inference node: parses an Isaac Lab-exported deploy.yaml, runs the ONNX policy, and computes PD-to-effort commands using the same gains as training. Ports the term registry from unitree_rl_lab's C++ hardware deploy path (deploy/include/isaaclab/envs/mdp/observations/observations.h) to ROS2 topics.
